crm_notes:
Summary: Strong fit for Redwood Private. Primary drivers: strict EU residency, auditability, and ability to host KMS CMK in customer account. Pelorus: mid-bank / regtech vertical; very prescriptive security team.

Notes from calls: - 'We need to own the keys; no vendor-held master keys' — Pelorus Infosec. - 'Audit trail must be immutable and retained 7 years; must integrate with our SIEM' — SecOps.

Vendor risk intake status: Pelorus completed intake template but flagged several TBDs: key rotation responsibilities, backup key escrow, and long-term log retention SLA. They expect Redwood to provide a SIG/CAIQ bundle plus evidence artifacts (SOC2 Type II, encryption in transit diagrams, pen test summary).

Shared responsibility points we documented: - Redwood manages runtime and infra in Private control plane; customer owns KMS CMKs and S3 for log retention. - Network: customer provides VPC subnets and peer; Redwood provides AMIs and control-plane services inside peered VPC. - Backups: Redwood to confirm encrypted backups can be delivered to customer's encrypted bucket or to customer-managed storage.

POC scope (requested): - Deploy Private VPC in eu-west-1, attach customer CMK, enable audit logging to customer's S3 (7y retention), run canonical chat+embedding workload for 72 hours, collect perf/cost telemetry.

Open questions / action items: - Provide final SIG/CAIQ (detailed answers) by 2026-03-12. - Confirm KMS key rotation process and whether Redwood needs a secondary key for snapshots. - Produce deployment & network diagram (deliverable: drive:/Pelorus/Architecture/Private-VPC-Design-v2.drawio). - Legal to approve ARA and billing (expected 2-3 weeks).
vendor_risk_summary: Risk intake: Medium-high due to finance vertical. Required evidence: SOC2 Type II, CAIQ, pen-test summary, KMS key ownership flow, SLA for audit log retention. Next deliverable: SIG/CAIQ + architecture diagrams + encryption process doc.
